verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Focus Time uses AI to flexibly defend a weekly focus goal, and that Habits flex around your schedule and adapt as things come up. Reclaim automatically reschedules smart events to the next best time when a higher-priority meeting overbooks them, guided by P1–P4 priorities. Community users corroborate that it reserves time for habits so meetings don't take over the day. Missing for 10: documented behavior when no alternative slot exists (the 'instead of dropping' guarantee), and clear independent hands-on confirmation of conflict-driven rescheduling (one early user reported the conflict test 'didn't work').
